## What changed

Describe the change and the educator, learner, contributor, or developer need it addresses.

## Evidence and judgement

- Name the research or evidence affected by this change.
- State whether the evidence strength or known limitations changed.
- Identify any original practitioner judgement explicitly.

Write “Not applicable” when the change is only documentation or infrastructure.

## Validation

- [ ] I preserved required skill frontmatter and named evidence sources.
- [ ] I did not include student data, private school information, credentials, or access tokens.
- [ ] I regenerated `registry.json` and the MCP skill bundle if any `SKILL.md` changed.
- [ ] I ran `npm test` or explained why it could not run.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.

## Limitations or follow-up

What remains uncertain, requires review, or should happen after this change?
